episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: With his new book release and a major investor presentation underway, nothing can stop the cynical Cem's rising success... or so he thinks.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Grappling with his critical inner voice, Cem comes to blows with Hazal, as she seamlessly infiltrates the empire he's built for himself.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Cem's past with his mother complicates his work with Hazal, especially when a woman enters the hospital wanting to know if she should pursue an affair.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: After a long-delayed visit to his mother's house, Cem stumbles upon a postcard that shatters one of his only fond memories from the past.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: In an effort to prove to himself — and to Hazal — that his romantic life is healthy, Cem finds himself self-sabotaging through compulsive tendencies.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: The "Love Hospital" delves into the business of platonic "sleep escorts," while Cem's panic attacks deter him from donating blood to help Halil.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Cem's own basic instincts fail him when he wakes up with new romantic feelings. Hazal is confused to see him suddenly treating patients with "love."

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: The "Love Hospital" welcomes an unexpected arrival, while Cem continues to treat himself for the worst affliction his clinic has ever seen: true love.
